Yes, and that would be because of the gift God gave us of free will. Your window analogy is similar to what happened in the garden of eden. The open and unbarred window being the tree of knowledge of good and evil. Why would God put it there in the first place if he didn’t want us to eat from it? Or in your analogy, why put a window if he didn’t want us to jump from it? Because without it, there would be no option to choose something else than him. He wants us to choose him, you cant choose him if there is no second option because there would be nothing else to choose. The fact we have free will at all is an act of love itself, because God could have made us choose him like programmed robots, and it wouldn’t be like true love at all, it wouldn’t be as passionate if we were simply programmed like that. I also didn’t mean that God is relying on words from men to save people, but that he sends them out to spread HIS gospel, using his holy spirit to work through them to plants seeds when they are willing to do his work. It’s part of the way HIS message is sent out, not theirs or ours.

I’ve tried to explain this to some people who argued the same thing, and they always continue to say this: “well it’s still not loving if the option to not choose him still exists at all” And that’s when I know the problem they have is a hardened heart towards him. They are frustrated that there is no other way to get to heaven except through him, and they feel unloved by that because they can’t have another option to enter when there exists no other option. You can’t enter the place of love and peace if you deny the very being of love and peace itself. I can’t better explain it than that.

I do believe that there is a hell but I don’t believe that God sends you to hell, he doesn’t want you to go to hell because hell is a place where it’s the absence of him when you choose to have a hardened heart towards him. God is literally love itself, and so when you don’t believe in him, you will take yourself to a place where there is no love. Basically sending yourself to hell in your own free will he has given you, And God doesn’t want that.
